submission.natural_language_explanation: At a token that continues a cohesive multi-token unit, head L3/H3 attends almost exclusively to the immediately preceding token (weight typically 0.85-1.0) to carry its content forward for composition. This covers later subword pieces of split words (ex|os, ore|ct, count|en, quarter|ing), the hyphen in half-compounds (half|-|sister), and the second word of tight collocations (van|der, number|four, half|of, People|'s); word-initial tokens that start a new, weakly predicted word stay at or near floor.

rival_explanations: The head fires on any predictable next word of a common bigram, including compositional possessives and ordinary function-word pairs, so tokens like the possessive in dog's dinner or the in in the lab should also fire strongly.
The head only stitches together single orthographic words (subword pieces and hyphen parts), so spaced completions such as number four, half of, or van der should stay at floor.
